checkpoint_split: FP32 model on system disk; Adam/RNG/counters on data disk; verify both before rotating old snapshot
loss: sum over response positions and full output vocabulary of student_p * (student_logp - frozen_teacher_logp), divided by the complete64-response batch token count
sampled_prefix_gradient: fixed rollout prefixes; direct conditional-distribution gradient only
student_precision: FP32 parameters and Adam, BF16 autocast
wandb_fallback: offline event files when the API remains HTTP403; never claim offline data was uploaded
storage: source-only model checkpoints and best/final models; incremental logs-only archive on minimind; no raw experiment files on Mac
scope: One seed0 OPD run. Match DAPO accepted response count and optimizer update budget, not total compute or supervision. No isolated algorithm-superiority claim.
